copy_heading: Know more about playing Australian Powerball online

sections.heading: How to Play Powerball Online?
sections.body_html:
To play Australian Powerball, simply choose 7 numbers from a field of 1 to 35 plus one Powerball number from a separate field of 1 to 20. When playing online with Lotto Express, you can choose your own numbers or choose Quick Pick, where numbers will be randomly assigned to your lottery ticket. It’s just like going to the store to purchase your lottery ticket without the hassle! You still have the same odds of winning a prize.

The Australian Powerball draw takes place every Thursday at 8:30 AEST.

sections.heading: Can you buy Australian Powerball tickets outside Australia?
sections.body_html: You can buy lottery tickets for Australian Powerball outside of Australia online with Lotto Express. When you play the lottery online, your ticket is bought from an official retailer in Australia and added to your account. You’ll get an email letting you know that your purchase is complete, alongside a reminder of your chosen numbers, or the Quick Pick numbers that have been assigned to you.

sections.heading: How to claim your Australian Powerball prize?
sections.body_html: When playing Powerball online, you don’t need to check your tickets. When you win a prize, no matter the size, Lotto Express will send a notification directly to your email inbox to tell you that you’ve won! Your prize money will then be deposited into your account once the official lottery results have been announced online.

sections.heading: How can you be sure to receive the Australian Powerball prize?
sections.body_html: Lotto Express have the highest security standards in the industry, so you can be sure that when you play Australian Powerball online, the lottery game is secure. When you play online lotteries with Lotto Express, you will receive notifications at every step. You will get email notification of ticket purchases, winning announcements and deposited funds in your account. The information is instantly available to you, and your prize fund winnings are 100% yours, as Lotto Express has no claim to your tickets as per our Terms and Conditions. If you win an Australian Powerball prize - you are guaranteed to receive that prize in full.

sections.heading: How do you win the Australian Powerball Lottery Online?
sections.body_html:
There are 9 ways to win when you play Australian Powerball with Lotto Express. If your ticket matches the 7 main numbers plus the Powerball number - you’ll be a Grand Prize winner! However, you are still able to win amazing prizes with fewer matches. There is a prize simply for matching the Powerball.

The jackpot prize for Australian Powerball starts at A$3 million. If there is no jackpot winner, it will roll over. The largest Australian Powerball jackpot to date is A$200 Million.

sections.heading: Why Play Australian Powerball with Lotto Express?
sections.body_html: Playing online with Lotto Express is a simple and secure way to play lotteries from around the world. Australian Powerball is notorious for having high jackpot prizes, which you can be in with a chance of winning if you buy your tickets online. You choose which lotteries you want to play, pick your numbers (or choose the Quick Pick option) and get immediate notification of your lottery ticket purchase.
